download.notInFolder: It isn't in the source folder
download.songCoreFailed: Placed, but SongCore couldn't load it
draft.addHint: Add the next candidate at the bottom

draft.discardHint: Drop this song without swapping (one song fewer)
draft.downloadHint: Download just this song now (it becomes a trial song and is deleted when its time runs out unless you play or favorite it)
draft.hint: Swap or drop songs that don't fit; if it looks good, “Create” downloads them and opens the playlist. Once a song is downloaded, its ↓ turns into a play button
draft.playHint: Select this song in the song list (press PLAY to play; you come back to the draft afterwards)
draft.retypeHint: Pick again with another type (genre, etc.)
draft.swapHint: Drop this song and swap in the next candidate

install.badFolderName: The folder name can't be used
install.extractedTooLarge: The extracted files are over the limit
install.hashMismatch: The contents have a different hash ({hash})

install.notBeatSaver: The zip isn't on BeatSaver over https
install.zipBadName: A name in the zip can't be used: {name}

item.unavailable: This song isn't in the current source, so it can't be downloaded

mix.listHint: Pick a song in the list to select it in song select
mix.name: {name} mix
mix.offMix: A song outside the “{song}” mix is selected (pick a song in the list to go back)
mix.tileHint: Pick a type and build a list starting from the selected song
next.hint: Tap to preview, ▶ to play it next
next.hintWithNext: Tap to preview, ▶ to play it next. Otherwise the list goes on to “{next}”
next.playHint: Make this the next song and go back to song select (downloads it first if needed)
next.title: Up next ({preset})
panel.autoNextOffHint: Off: the next song is not selected after you finish (songs picked on the results screen still are). Press to turn on
panel.autoNextOnHint: On: after you finish a song from the mix, select the next song in the list when you are back in song select. Press to turn off
panel.filterHint: Switch what the list shows: All → Familiar (installed only) → New songs (not installed yet)
panel.getHint: Download the selected song and select it in song select
panel.pinHint: Switch between pinning and moving the panel. Moving shows a handle on top and a button beside the pin to put the panel back
panel.resetHint: Put the panel back where it started (above the song list)
panel.saveHint: Keep the current list as a playlist
playlist.mixDescription: The OctantPath mix (replaced each time you create one)
playlist.notOurs: {file}.bplist wasn't made by OctantPath, so it isn't rewritten

playlist.trialDescription: Maps OctantPath downloaded from OctantCompass recommendations
playlist.unreadable: Can't read {file}.bplist, so it isn't rewritten
presets.failed: Couldn't get the list of mix types ({detail})
presets.none: Haven't received the mix types from OctantCompass
profile.clearCurveNotYet: Chance of clearing: not learned yet
profile.notEnough: Not enough plays yet to estimate your skill
profileView.title: Estimated skill and taste
recommend.badRequest: OctantCompass said the request was malformed: {error}
recommend.seedNotEmbedded: No recommendations (this song hasn't been computed in the DB yet)
recommend.seedNotInDb: No recommendations (the starting map isn't in the DB)
recommend.unknownPreset: That button isn't in OctantCompass's current list. The buttons were rebuilt
seed.noneChoice: No starting song (pick a song to also get types that start from it)
seed.nonePick: No starting song (pick a custom song and difficulty)
select.done: Selected in song select. Press PLAY to start
select.failed: Couldn't select it in song select. Pick it from the OctantPath pack
settings.autoDeleteHint: While off, nothing is deleted; the maps that would be deleted are only written to the log
settings.autoDownloadHint: When off, trial frames and the next songs of a mix aren't downloaded automatically. Clearing the trial songs already downloaded (expiry and total limit) goes on regardless of this setting
settings.exportSummaryHint: Writes a summary of the recommendations (per type: shown, downloaded, played, cleared) to UserData/OctantPath/summaries. Nothing is sent
settings.languageHint: Language of OctantPath's screens. Used after pressing OK (the game restarts its menu)
settings.mixDraftCountHint: How many songs a mix lists before you create it
settings.mixPrefetchCountHint: How many of the next songs in a mix are downloaded in advance (only while auto download is on)
settings.panelOpacityHint: How solid the background of the floating panels is. Raise it if bright things behind the panel make the text hard to read
settings.panelScaleHint: Size of the recommendation panel over song select (relative to BSML's standard floating screen)
settings.trialExpiryHint: Trial songs still on trial after this many days (only days you launch the game count) are deleted at launch (along with the size limit; songs you played a few times are kept)
settings.trialMaxHint: When the trial songs go over this, the oldest are deleted at launch (along with the day limit; songs in other playlists are kept)
signals.countMismatch: OctantCompass holds {host} signals, not the {sent} that were sent
signals.logUnreadable: Can't read the signal record, so collecting and sending are stopped: {error}
songButton.hint: Pick a mix type and build a list starting from this song (OctantPath)
trial.added: Added {total} songs to the trial slots
trial.ledgerUnreadable: Can't read the ownership record, so the trial slots aren't filled
